boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Cincinnati
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops on or immediately beside UC’s Clifton campus area, selected from direct business sources with published late hours.

cards.title: Raising Cane’s on Calhoun Street
cards.subtitle: 237 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Use the Calhoun Street location page to check service details before heading over; it lists dine-in hours through 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street chicken-finger stop with 3 a.m. published hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 237 Calhoun Street Cincinnati restaurant as open 10 a.m.–3 a.m. daily, including dine-in service.
cards.access_notes: Published dine-in hours: 10 a.m.–3 a.m. daily; verify holiday changes on the location page.

cards.title: Shake Shack Clifton
cards.subtitle: 249 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the location page for the day’s closing time, then use its listed pickup, delivery, or dine-in options for a Calhoun Street stop.
cards.short_summary: A Clifton Shake Shack with hours to 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack lists the Clifton location at 249 Calhoun Street open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published store hours: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Toppers Pizza on Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 345 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Use the Cincinnati entry in Toppers’ official locator to confirm the day’s window before ordering pickup or delivery from Calhoun Street.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street pizza option with published hours into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers lists its Cincinnati restaurant at 345 Calhoun Street open until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published Cincinnati hours: 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 a.m.–3:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Cinnabon on Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 271 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Consult the official location page for any day-specific updates; its posted schedule makes this a later dessert or snack option on Calhoun.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street bakery open until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Cinnabon lists its 271 Calhoun Street Cincinnati bakery open until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday; until 10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Auntie Anne’s at 271 Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 271 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the official Cincinnati listing before you go; it publishes late-evening hours and identifies the suite within the Calhoun Street address.
cards.short_summary: A pretzel counter with posted 11 p.m. hours most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Auntie Anne’s lists its Cincinnati location at 271 Calhoun Street, Suite 510B, open until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 11 p.m. Monday–Saturday; until 10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Adriatico’s UC
cards.subtitle: 113 W McMillan Ave, near UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Use Adriatico’s UC location page for dine-in and pickup timing; it distinguishes the restaurant closing time from the dine-in cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A West McMillan pizza shop with late pickup and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Adriatico’s UC lists its Cincinnati location at 113 West McMillan Avenue open until 11 p.m. Monday–Wednesday, midnight Friday–Saturday, and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published closing times include 11 p.m. Monday–Wednesday and midnight Friday–Saturday; the page lists separate dine-in end times.

cards.title: Chicago Gyros & Dogs on McMillan
cards.subtitle: 201 W McMillan St, near UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s own site for the current day before walking over; it posts 10 p.m. closing Monday through Saturday and 9 p.m. Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A nearby gyro and hot-dog restaurant with published 10 p.m. weekday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Gyros & Dogs lists its Cincinnati location at 201 West McMillan Street open 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and until 9 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 10 p.m. Monday–Saturday; until 9 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Sichuan Palace on Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 343 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official page to verify the day, especially its Tuesday closure, before planning a pickup stop on Calhoun Street.
cards.short_summary: A Calhoun Street Chinese restaurant with posted 9 p.m. service on open days.
cards.evidence_claim: Sichuan Palace lists its Cincinnati location at 343 Calhoun Street open until 9 p.m. Sunday, Monday, and Wednesday–Saturday; it is closed Tuesday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11:30 a.m.–9 p.m. Sunday, Monday, and Wednesday–Saturday; closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Hummus Republic on Calhoun
cards.subtitle: 257 Calhoun St, beside UC Main Campus
cards.notes: Check the official Cincinnati location page for daily service status, then use its listed dine-in, pickup, or delivery options from Calhoun Street.
cards.short_summary: A Mediterranean bowl, wrap, and pita counter with published 9 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hummus Republic lists its Cincinnati location at 257 Calhoun Street open 11 a.m.–9 p.m. daily and offering pickup, delivery, and dine-in.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11 a.m.–9 p.m. daily; the location page lists pickup, delivery, and dine-in.

cards.title: The 86 Coffee Bar
cards.subtitle: University of Cincinnati Main Campus
cards.notes: Review UC Dining’s live hours page before visiting, since it flags special schedules; the listed regular schedule keeps this campus coffee stop open until 9 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee bar with 9 p.m. regular hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Dining lists The 86 Coffee Bar’s regular hours as until 9 p.m. Monday–Sunday, with varying opening times by day.
cards.source_title: University of Cincinnati Dining — Hours of Operation
cards.access_notes: UC Dining lists regular closing at 9 p.m. daily; the same page notes special and break schedules, so check it before departure.
